decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system builds on the firm's existing controls and robust specialist lighting capabilities, so it can interpret early results and improve the product.
This general interior lighting luminaire is close to the firm's core lighting knowledge and R&D, making it easy to assimilate feedback and unlikely to drop.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics leverages the firm's optical and interior lighting expertise, supporting learning and continued development.
The marine searchlight is related to the firm's outdoor and robust lighting know-how, though less central, so the firm can still interpret its early results and is likely to keep it.
